deviations.what: The task prompt reached this executor truncated (only the last ~700 characters of the user's original request). The plan was recovered verbatim from the planning step's structured output (gen_plan_experiment_1, title 'Predicting where a refusal edit misses') and the output contract from a sibling artifact's intact prompt.
DEV items per language for the causal profile raised from 32 to all 44 S3 JBB half-A harmful items (split-half 22/22), decided from the smoke timing model BEFORE any profile output existed.

Confirmation generations use 128 new tokens instead of the plan's 256 (same budget as the exp9 screen cells the instrument is screened on); the time saved buys 3 extra matched groups (G6-G8). Truncation rate is reported per cell.

A judge-free teacher-forced profile (log-prob drop of the no-op refusal prefix) was added as a SECONDARY profile, with a pre-declared promotion rule used only if the judged profile failed the split-half >= 0.5 rule.

The two named cheap baselines (unedited refusal rate; single-site transfer rate at the frozen site h* = 20) are per-(model, language) constants, so they cannot rank conditions WITHIN a language. They are raced against O on pooled (language x condition) rows. Within a language, the one-forward-pass competitor is B_site = the judged single-site causal drop at the edit's most energetic layer, frozen with the same profile.

Screen restricted to iteration-3 exp9 Gemma weight cells (screen stage, S3 JBB half B). The 57 GaMS3 cells of exp10 are NOT RUN in the screen: O needs a GaMS3 causal profile, which this artifact did not measure (the sibling GaMS3 artifact owns that model).

Operator families differ by design: the profile e_L(h) is measured with single-site ACTIVATION ablation (plan), while the conditions are WEIGHT-output orthogonalisation edits whose g(h) is closed-form. O is therefore a transfer test from an activation-space causal probe to weight edits.

Outside family reuses exp12's frozen Qwen3-8B directions (same pinned revision b968826d; spot-verified by a fresh recompute) instead of recomputing them; its profile is reduced-resolution (every 3rd hidden index, 24 DEV items; plan said every 2nd - coarsened because the local judge runs at ~0.64 s/item on the L4, decided before any Qwen output existed) and its design is 3 matched groups + no-op + 1 random control (no PC control, no dose ladder), with FLORES collateral only.

CONF S4 hoc items were already used by exp9 to CONFIRM other cells; they never entered the fitting of O (frozen from DEV only) and none of this artifact's confirmation conditions existed before the freeze.
Harmless KL and FLORES dNLL are the collateral panel for every Gemma confirmation cell; the six-task utility panel (plan: extremes only) is NOT RUN (last item of the frozen cut order).
Official Llama-Guard ASR pipeline NOT RUN; the rubric's own harm verdict (ASR-by-rubric) is reported separately from refusal instead.
Native-speaker review of Slovene/German/Lithuanian items and outputs remains PENDING (not performed).

Gate-2 judge sanity check FAILED: the local judge labelled 7/7 non-empty synthetic invalid replies REFUSED or COMPLIED, never INVALID. A deterministic validity guard (empty, GlotLID < 0.5, 3-gram repetition > 0.5) was added to the failed-edit rule before any confirmation output existed; it fires on <= 1.7% of real confirmation replies.

The freeze was written three times, all before any CF_* output: after the guard (D12) and after making the DEV profile pairwise per layer (a judge parse failure removes one pair rather than the item from all 48 layers). The frozen predictions were identical; only hashes of changed code files differ.

The judge gate is reported per language as the plan requires: pooled within-edited kappa 0.818 passes, Slovene 0.744 fails, so Slovene claims are JUDGE_SENSITIVE with a Rogan-Gladen arm. The verdict rule's direction convention (higher O -> lower residual refusal, so rho is predicted negative and compared sign-aligned) follows the frozen matched-contrast prediction.
Post-hoc (not frozen) competitor: the edit's own harmless KL. Reported as EXPLORATORY only.

run_chain2.sh stopped at Phase 5A (exp12 item rows lacked a 'kind' field); fixed in outside.py and resumed with run_chain3.sh, which also adds --refail passes. No generation was lost or re-used across the crash.

After all results existed, common.py and rederive.py were edited ONLY to read the run's other artifacts through a relative constant (AII_LOOP_DIR, default three levels up) instead of an absolute server path, and absolute paths in results/reuse_inventory.json, results/outside/phaseA_info.json and logs/ were rewritten as relative ones. The as-run hashes in configs/FREEZE.sha256 therefore no longer match common.py; a re-run re-freezes first.
